messages.content: Extract native METAR report-label measurements from the lawfully supplied text. This is not physical truth or a future observation. Return exactly one JSON object with a slots object keyed by every supplied read query_id. Each slot has visibility, temperature_c, dewpoint_c. visibility is null or an object with lower, upper, lower_closed, upper_closed in metres. Use the string +inf for an unbounded upper endpoint. Preserve inequalities and censoring: P6SM means lower=9656.064, lower_closed=false, upper=+inf; M1/4SM has an open upper endpoint at 402.336. One statute mile is 1609.344 metres. Temperatures and dewpoints are degrees Celsius, M denotes minus, and missing fields are null. Use only the main routine observation before remarks/trends; TAF is a forecast, not a station observation. A missing or conflicting source slot has null fields. Do not fill unread slots. A bare JSON object or one whole JSON markdown fence is accepted; no other prose, duplicate keys, NaN or extra fields. Future outcomes are unavailable. The supplied professional forecast remains common information; you are only extracting the past report measurements.
